Meridian ↔ Dub design system comparison documents token alignment and conflicts: Border radius partially aligned — Meridian uses 3 values (12/10/2px) vs Dub's 5 (9999/16/12/8/6px); 12px card radius is common but pill (9999px) deliberately absent in Meridian per DESIGN.md:918-926. Accent color conflicts — Meridian has no interaction color (primary action is black pill) while Dub uses electric blue (#2563eb) and CTA blue (#1e40af), violating the Money Rule in DESIGN.md:405. Electric Blue (#2563eb) rejected specifically because its hue (250°) conflicts with data-scale band (--dv-n* pole); decorative/interaction colors compete with severity and direction channels for attention. Deep Sapphire (#1e40af) for CTA maps to existing Meridian --accent (black pill day, warm light night); Dub's own primary-action-fill is already #000000. Green accent conflict — Dub's mint #dcfce7 is a supporting accent but Meridian reserves green exclusively for severity-3. Body size conflict — Meridian uses 13px compact as dominant while Dub uses 16px canonical, creating ~23% density difference; Meridian designed for single expert's long shifts. Sidebar nav divergence — Dub's #dbeaff chromatic fill violates Role 1 (structure must be achromatic); Meridian uses left border strip instead. Üç test vakası (a, b, c) değerlendirildi: (a) dormant_setup uyuyan planlar ilk koşutta düştü, KATMAN-4 (alan düzeyi merceği) eklenerek yalnız-görünürlük (disk düzeyinde) düzeltildi — ölü mekanizma bir dosyanın tamamı değil, canlı bir defterin İÇİNDEKİ bir ALAN olabilir; trade_plans.jsonl artefakt olarak davranışsal, dormant_setup alanı ölü; mercek: bir KONTROL alanı diske yazılıyorsa, o alanı diskten okuyan taraflar dallanıyor mu yoksa yalnız etiketliyor/çiziyor mu?
